title: Additivity of the Shapley value
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $I$ be a finite type, let $g_j$ be a real-valued function on the subsets of an $n$-element set for each $j\in I$, and let $i$ be an element of that set. The Shapley value at $i$ of the pointwise sum of the games $g_j$ equals the sum of their Shapley values at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ assigns a real-valued subset function to each $j\in I$
$i$ is an element of the $n$-element set
